clips.title: The story
paras: Silverwind Refuge is a serene night elven settlement nestled in south-central Ashenvale, situated just north of Mystral Lake. Protected by Sentinels and allied water elementals, it offers a welcoming haven for travelers along the forest's wooded trails.

Resting between the placid waters of Mystral Lake and Iris Lake to the north, Silverwind Refuge stands as one of the major night elven waystations in central Ashenvale alongside Astranaar. It boasts a comfortable inn, craftsmen, and wilderness trainers who instruct travelers in herbalism, alchemy, skinning, and hunting. Guarded by stalwart Sentinels alongside local water spirits, the retreat serves as a peaceful rest stop for allies moving through the shaded ancient woods.
